source_profile.provenance: Locally authored from scratch by the focused C++ selector at runtime; all generated drawings are removed with the temporary directory.

contract.dwg: ODA v5.4.1 §20.4.49 defines TOLERANCE's DIMSTYLE field as a hard pointer.
contract.dxf: Autodesk's TOLERANCE DXF table defines group 3 as the dimension-style name.
contract.required_projection: Resolve the source hard pointer against the loaded DIMSTYLE table and write the exact table name; refuse an unresolved pointer instead of emitting the constructor default STANDARD.

implementation.reader: src/intern/dwgreader.cpp resolves DRW_Tolerance::dimStyleH.ref through the existing findTableName(DRW::DIMSTYLE, ...) source map before callback delivery.
implementation.writer: src/libdxfrw.cpp rejects an empty TOLERANCE dimStyleName before opening the entity record scope, with an unresolved-tolerance-dimstyle diagnostic.
implementation.test: tests/dwg2dxf_adapter_tests.cpp runtime-authors valid and missing-target AC1024 DWGs, then checks ASCII/Binary DXF output, typed readback, atomic refusal, destination preservation, and same-adapter corrected retry.

results.custom_style_handle_to_name: PASS: ANSI-25 DIMSTYLE handle resolves exactly and survives both DXF encodings.
results.missing_target: PASS: absent hard-pointer target produces an empty unresolved name and strict output refusal.
results.rollback_and_retry: PASS: sentinel destination survives both refusals; correcting the handle/name lets the same adapter write and read back ANSI-25.

sources.title: ODA Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1 §20.4.49 TOLERANCE (46)

claim_boundary: Generated AC1024 handle-to-name transport and fail-closed behavior only. No physical producer breadth, tolerance rendering, GD&T semantics, native-consumer behavior, or general support claim is established.
